## What does this PR change? / 这个 PR 改了什么？



## Type / 类型

- [ ] Paper / 论文
- [ ] Course module / 课程模块
- [ ] Lab / 实验
- [ ] Course links / 课程链接
- [ ] Website / 网站
- [ ] Other / 其他

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] Both languages updated, or the PR says which one is missing / 已同时更新中英文，或已注明缺少哪种语言
- [ ] `npm run build` passes in `website/` (if the site changed) / 网站改动已通过 `npm run build`
- [ ] Changed notebooks run top to bottom on CPU (if a lab changed) / 修改的 Notebook 能在 CPU 上完整运行
- [ ] Papers and links are real and verifiable / 论文与链接真实可验证
- [ ] No third-party PDFs or slides committed / 未提交第三方 PDF 或 slides
